name: Native and React forms retain failed requests and reset after synthetic success
description: Owned fictional Stage 4 QA server only. All delivery is local synthetic handling, no customer/provider delivery. Verify actual failure and success lifecycle on native Contact and authored Drain cleaning pages.

planSteps.description: Open /contact/. Use only these synthetic values: Your name Stage 4 Synthetic; Phone number 555-0101; Email address stage4@example.test; How can we help? Stage 4 synthetic request. Submit Discuss your request.
The form displays Synthetic delivery failed. No lead was sent. All four input values remain; there is no Thank you message.
Submit the same retained form again without changing its fields.
The form displays Thank you. We will be in touch shortly. Name, phone, email and message are now empty.
Open /services/drain-cleaning/ directly. The H1 is Drain cleaning. Expand What should I describe in my first enquiry?
The answer says Explain which concern prompted your enquiry and when you first noticed it. The page-specific introduction mentions fixtures that drain slowly.
At the contact form fill the same four synthetic values and submit Discuss your request.
The React form displays Synthetic delivery failed. No lead was sent. All four input values remain unchanged.
Submit the same retained React form again.
The form displays Thank you. We will be in touch shortly. All four input fields are empty.
Open /locations/testville/ and expand What access detail should I confirm? Do not submit further forms or follow external email/phone links.
The route shows Testville and the supported answer about asking the property owner whether side gate access can be made available. A contextual image appears.
